hotels.description: Explore Australia’s glorious Queensland coast with a stay at Holiday Inn & Suites Sunshine Coast. Immerse yourself in the beauty that drapes this coastal city, from the flawless beaches to the calming laid-back vibe of the locals. Wander through the national parks, discover secret swimming holes and endless stretches of beach, before returning to your modern room in the heart of Maroochydore City's CBD.

hotels.title: Sunshine Coast Beachside Two-Bedroom Apartments in Maroochydore with Outdoor Pool & BBQ Facilities
hotels.description: Surrender to the unhurried rhythm of the Sunshine Coast at this collection of seaside apartments, mere moments from the surf-friendly beaches of Maroochydore. Make yourself at home in paradise with oversized living areas, fully equipped kitchens and balconies perfectly suited to balmy evenings under the stars. Spend lazy days beside the sparkling pool or stretched out on white sands, before venturing out to explore Ocean Street’s dining district and eclectic beach boutiques or head to the iconic Australia Zoo. When the day is done, gather on the rooftop and fire up the barbecue, as the last light fades over the Pacific.
